abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 5. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |

| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 329 | 600 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 421 | 600 |
